instruction.name: AESENCWIDE128KL
instruction.copyright: Copyright (C) Intel Corporation. All Rights Reserved.
instruction.shortdesc: Perform Ten Rounds of AES Encryption Flow With Key Locker on 8 Blocks Using 128-Bit Key

para.string: Further details on Key Locker and usage of this instruction can be found here:

instruction performs ten rounds of AES to encrypt each of the eight blocks in XMM0-7 using the 128-bit key indicated by the handle from the second operand. It replaces each input block in XMM0-7 with its corresponding encrypted block if the operation succeeds (e.g., does not run into a handle violation failure).
ZF is set to 0 if the operation succeeded and set to 1 if the operation failed due to a handle violation. The other arithmetic flags (OF, SF, AF, PF, CF) are cleared to 0.

programlisting.string: AESENCWIDE128KL unsigned char _mm_aesencwide128kl_u8(__m128i odata[8], const __m128i idata[8], const void* h);
